series.name: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 hybrid inverter
series.notes: Pakistan launch SKU. Warning table (ch.8) and fault table (ch.9) reuse identical numeric strings with DIFFERENT meanings - always read whether the manual called it a warning or a fault. Cross-checked against the Apollo-4K6/5K6LP1G01-MX guide (doc 358-S010018-00) which prints a byte-identical code table; not duplicated here. Codes 03, 05, 08, 09, 12, 13, 18, 27, 32, 37, 41, 55-82, 84-86, 88+ are absent from the printed table.

title.ur: Warning 25 Grid phase ka sequence ghalat

meaning.en: The input and output power lines do not correspond; the unit is in a setup state.
meaning.ur: Input aur output power lines aik doosre se match nahi kar rahi; unit setup state mein hai.

causes.en: Manual says this warning normally appears right after a three-phase parallel setup is finished, and is expected.
causes.ur: Manual ke mutabiq yeh warning three-phase parallel setup khatam hone ke foran baad aati hai aur normal hai.

causes.en: Grid and load phases genuinely cross-connected on a three-phase parallel bank
causes.ur: Three-phase parallel bank par grid aur load ke phases haqeeqan aik doosre se Jude hain

solutions.en: If parallel setup was just completed, switch the inverter off and on once; the warning clears by itself.
solutions.ur: Agar parallel setup abhi mukammal hua hai to inverter ko aik baar off/on karein; warning khud hat jayegi.

solutions.en: Confirm every unit in the bank has the same phase assigned (3P1/3P2/3P3) in LCD program 28.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke bank ke har unit ka LCD program 28 mein wohi phase set hai (3P1/3P2/3P3).

solutions.en: Check that the grid input and the load output phases correspond one-to-one at the terminal block.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke terminal block par grid input aur load output ke phases aik doosre se match karte hain.

notes.en: The manual explicitly states this warning is normal after a parallel installation, so do not send the customer away before completing the parallel setup.
notes.ur: Manual saaf likhta hai ke parallel installation ke baad yeh warning normal hai, is liye parallel setup mukammal karne se pehle customer ko bhejein mat.

source.title: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-S010002-05A)

aliases: BMS doesn't allow inverter to discharge battery

title.ur: Warning 51 BMS discharge rok raha hai

meaning.en: The BMS has told the inverter not to discharge; the inverter stops discharging automatically.
meaning.ur: BMS ne inverter ko discharge na karne ko kaha hai; inverter khud-ba-khud discharging band kar deta hai.

causes.en: Battery cell voltage hit the BMS discharge cut-off
causes.ur: Battery cell ka voltage BMS discharge cut-off par pohanch gaya

causes.en: Battery temperature outside the BMS permitted range
causes.ur: Battery temperature BMS ke allowed range se bahar hai

causes.en: Pack over-current or over-temperature event latched by the BMS
causes.ur: BMS ne pack ka over-current ya over-temperature event latch kar liya

solutions.en: Read the BMS status on the LCD BMS page and note the reported battery voltage and temperature.
solutions.ur: LCD BMS page par BMS status padhein aur battery voltage aur temperature note karein.

solutions.en: Charge the battery from PV or grid until the BMS releases the inhibit, then confirm discharging resumes.
solutions.ur: Battery ko PV ya grid se charge karein jab tak BMS inhibit na chhode, phir discharging resume hone ka confirm karein.

solutions.en: Check the pack temperature sensor and the ambient temperature at the battery location.
solutions.ur: Pack ka temperature sensor aur battery ki jagah ka ambient temperature check karein.

source.title: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-S010002-05A)

aliases: BMS require inverter to charge battery

title.ur: Warning 52 BMS charging maang raha hai

meaning.en: The BMS has asked the inverter to charge the battery; the inverter charges automatically.
meaning.ur: BMS ne inverter se battery charge karne ko kaha hai; inverter khud-ba-khud charge karta hai.

causes.en: Battery SOC below the BMS balancing or recovery threshold
causes.ur: Battery SOC BMS balancing ya recovery threshold se neeche hai

causes.en: Cell imbalance detected, so the BMS wants a top-up charge
causes.ur: Cell imbalance detect hua hai, is liye BMS top-up charge chahta hai

causes.en: Battery was stored long enough for the BMS to request recovery charge
causes.ur: Battery itni der rahi ke BMS ne recovery charge maang liya

solutions.en: Allow the automatic charge to complete; interrupting it repeatedly keeps the BMS request active.
solutions.ur: Automatic charge poora hone dein; baar baar rokne se BMS ki request qayamat rehti hai.

solutions.en: Confirm charge current is not set to 0 A for this pack in the LCD setup.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke LCD setup mein is pack ka charge current 0 A par set to nahi hai.

solutions.en: If the request never clears, read the BMS fault code on the LCD and treat it as a BMS-side fault.
solutions.ur: Agar request kabhi clear na ho to LCD par BMS fault code padhein aur use BMS side ka fault samajhein.

source.title: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-S010002-05A)

meaning.en: The BMS firmware needs to be upgraded.
meaning.ur: BMS ka firmware update karna zaroori hai.

causes.en: New battery pack fitted with older BMS firmware than the inverter expects
causes.ur: Naya battery pack lagai gaya hai jiska BMS firmware inverter se purana hai

causes.en: BMS firmware version not matched to the inverter firmware after an update
causes.ur: Inverter firmware update ke baad BMS firmware version match nahi hua

causes.en: Pack supplied with a firmware revision that predates the current protocol
causes.ur: Pack aisa firmware revision ke sath aaya hai jo current protocol se purana hai

solutions.en: Note the BMS version and SOC shown on the LCD BMS information page.
solutions.ur: LCD BMS information page par dikhne wala BMS version aur SOC note karein.

solutions.en: Update the BMS firmware through the Felicity app while the pack is connected and awake.
solutions.ur: Pack connected aur awake hone par Felicity app se BMS firmware update karein.

solutions.en: Do not parallel a pack with mismatched BMS firmware; update every pack in the bank.
solutions.ur: Alag BMS firmware wale pack ko parallel na karein; bank ke har pack ko update karein.

source.title: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-S010002-05A)

meaning.en: PV string voltage is above the MPPT window; the number of modules in series must be reduced.
meaning.ur: PV string ka voltage MPPT window se upar hai; series ke modules ki kami karni hogi.

causes.en: Too many modules in series for cold-morning open-circuit voltage
causes.ur: Series mein modules subah ke thande waqt ke open-circuit voltage ke liye zyada hain

causes.en: Array designed for a higher max PV voltage than this inverter
causes.ur: Array is inverter se zyada max PV voltage ke liye design kiya gaya

solutions.en: Measure PV open-circuit voltage with a meter and compare it with the inverter's MPPT upper limit.
solutions.ur: Meter se PV ka open-circuit voltage measure karke inverter ke MPPT upper limit se compare karein.

solutions.en: Reduce the number of modules in series, or switch the PV type setting in the app to match.
solutions.ur: Series mein modules ki kami karein, ya app mein PV type setting usi ke mutabiq karein.

solutions.en: Confirm no MPPT is assigned to an unconnected string, which inflates the reading.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke koi MPPT aise string par set na ho jo connected nahi, warna reading barh jati hai.

source.title: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-S010002-05A)

aliases: Over current happen at PV port

meaning.en: Overcurrent at the PV port; the unit has cut output.
meaning.ur: PV port par over current hai; unit ne output band kar diya hai.

causes.en: Parallel strings with mismatched module ratings on one MPPT
causes.ur: Aik MPPT par alag ratings ke modules ke strings parallel lage hain

causes.en: Insulation fault on the string creating a leakage path
causes.ur: String par insulation fault jo leakage path bana raha hai

causes.en: PV input surge from a nearby lightning event
causes.ur: Paas ke lightning event se PV input par surge

solutions.en: Isolate PV at the DC isolator, then clamp-meter each string separately to find the high one.
solutions.ur: DC isolator se PV isolate karke har string ko alag alag clamp meter se measure karke zyada wala dhoondein.

solutions.en: Megohmmeter-test the string insulation to earth before reconnecting anything.
solutions.ur: Kuch bhi wapas lagane se pehle string ki earth insulation megohmmeter se test karein.

solutions.en: Check the DC SPD condition; a spent SPD lets surge straight into the MPPT stage.
solutions.ur: DC SPD ki halat check karein; kharab SPD surge ko seedha MPPT stage mein chhor deta hai.

source.title: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-S010002-05A)

aliases: Short circuit happen at PV port

title.ur: Fault 04 PV port par short circuit

meaning.en: Short circuit at the PV port; check that the wiring is connected well.
meaning.ur: PV port par short circuit hai; check karein ke wiring theek lagi hai.

causes.en: MC4 connector not fully clicked, leaving partial contact that arcs
causes.ur: MC4 connector poori tarah click nahi hua, partial contact se arc ban raha hai

causes.en: Cable insulation chafed against the array frame
causes.ur: Cable ki insulation array frame se ragad gayi

causes.en: Panel laminate broken allowing current to earth
causes.ur: Panel ka laminate toota hai jis se earth mein current ja raha hai

solutions.en: Isolate PV at the DC isolator and switch off the AC side before touching any connector.
solutions.ur: Koi bhi connector chhoone se pehle DC isolator se PV aur AC side band karein.

solutions.en: Disconnect and re-make every MC4 pair by hand until each clicks; do not force with pliers.
solutions.ur: Har MC4 pair ko haath se nikal kar dobara laga dein jab tak click na ho; pliers se zor na dein.

solutions.en: Megohmmeter-test each string to earth and replace any cable or panel that fails.
solutions.ur: Har string ki earth insulation megohmmeter se test karke fail hone wala cable ya panel replace karein.

source.title: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-S010002-05A)

meaning.en: The PV current sensor has failed.
meaning.ur: PV current sensor kharab ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Hall sensor on the MPPT board dead
causes.ur: MPPT board par Hall sensor kharab ho gaya

causes.en: Sensor harness disconnected during a board replacement
causes.ur: Board badalne ke dauran sensor harness nikal gaya

causes.en: Sensor drift after a surge event
causes.ur: Surge event ke baad sensor drift ho gaya

solutions.en: Compare the PV power shown on the LCD with a clamp meter on the string; zero or frozen means sensor failure.
solutions.ur: LCD par dikhne wali PV power ko string par clamp meter se compare karein; zero ya jam hui power sensor failure hai.

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then reseat the MPPT current sensor connector on the board.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke board par MPPT current sensor ka connector dobara laga dein.

solutions.en: Have the MPPT current sensor replaced and calibrated at the service centre.
solutions.ur: Service centre par MPPT current sensor replace aur calibrate karwayein.

source.title: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-S010002-05A)

meaning.en: Battery voltage is too high; check that battery spec and quantity meet requirements.
meaning.ur: Battery ka voltage bohat zyada hai; check karein ke battery ki spec aur quantity requirements poori karti hai.

causes.en: Too many 12 V batteries in series for a 48 V system
causes.ur: 48 V system ke liye series mein 12 V batteries zyada hain

causes.en: Mixed battery models or mixed capacities in the string
causes.ur: String mein alag alag battery model ya capacity mili hui hai

causes.en: Grid charge voltage set too high for the pack
causes.ur: Grid charge voltage pack ke liye zyada set ki gayi hai

solutions.en: Count the batteries in series and confirm the total matches this model's battery voltage range.
solutions.ur: Series mein batteries gin kar confirm karein ke total is model ki battery voltage range se match karta hai.

solutions.en: Measure each battery's voltage with a meter; any cell group far from the others should be replaced.
solutions.ur: Meter se har battery ka voltage measure karein; doosron se barhi door wala group replace karna hoga.

solutions.en: Reset the grid charge voltage to the pack's specified value in the LCD setup.
solutions.ur: LCD setup mein grid charge voltage pack ki specified value par reset karein.

source.title: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-S010002-05A)

title.ur: Fault 10 LLC circuit abnormal chal raha hai

meaning.en: The LLC resonant converter in the unit is not working normally.
meaning.ur: Unit ka LLC resonant converter theek se kaam nahi kar raha.

causes.en: LLC switching device failed
causes.ur: LLC switching device kharab ho gaya

causes.en: Output load beyond what the LLC stage can supply
causes.ur: Output load LLC stage ke liye zyada hai

causes.en: Bus voltage not within the LLC operating window at startup
causes.ur: Startup par bus voltage LLC operating window ke andar nahi hai

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then reduce the connected load to the minimum before restarting.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke restart se pehle connected load kam se kam karein.

solutions.en: Check for a burnt smell or visible damage on the LLC stage and the heatsink above it.
solutions.ur: LLC stage aur uske upar wale heatsink par jhazon ki smell ya nazaray dekhne wala damage dekhein.

solutions.en: Have the LLC stage and its gate driver tested at the service centre before returning the unit.
solutions.ur: Unit wapas dene se pehle service centre par LLC stage aur uska gate driver test karwayein.

source.title: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-S010002-05A)

meaning.en: Overcurrent in the Buck-boost converter; the unit has cut output.
meaning.ur: Buck-boost converter mein over current hai; unit ne output band kar diya hai.

causes.en: Output load exceeds the inverter rating
causes.ur: Output load inverter rating se zyada hai

causes.en: Buck-boost inductor or switching device damaged
causes.ur: Buck-boost ka inductor ya switching device kharab hai

causes.en: Battery current limit set above the pack rating
causes.ur: Battery current limit pack rating se upar set hai

solutions.en: Switch off most loads and restart; confirm the fault clears to prove it is a load-side trip.
solutions.ur: Boht se loads band karke restart karein; fault hat jaye to confirm ho gaya ke load side ka trip hai.

solutions.en: Set the battery charge/discharge current in the setup within the pack rating.
solutions.ur: Setup mein battery charge/discharge current pack rating ke andar set karein.

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery and have the Buck-boost stage inspected if it trips with no load.
solutions.ur: Bina load ke bhi trip ho to AC, PV aur battery isolate karke Buck-boost stage ka muaina karwayein.

source.title: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-S010002-05A)

title.ur: Fault 14 Buck-boost out of balance hai

meaning.en: The two Buck-boost channels are not sharing current evenly.
meaning.ur: Dono Buck-boost channels current aik saath baant nahi rahe.

causes.en: One Buck-boost current sensor reading low
causes.ur: Aik Buck-boost current sensor kam reading kar raha hai

causes.en: One Buck-boost channel's output current limiting hard
causes.ur: Aik Buck-boost channel ka output current bohat zyada limit ho raha hai

causes.en: Internal component failure in one channel
causes.ur: Aik channel mein internal component ki failure

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then read both Buck-boost channel currents if the LCD exposes them.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke LCD par dono Buck-boost channel ke current padhein (agar LCD dikhaye).

solutions.en: Have each channel's current sensor calibrated separately at the service centre.
solutions.ur: Service centre par har channel ka current sensor alag alag calibrate karwayein.

solutions.en: Do not run a long parallel bank on a unit that trips code 14; the unbalanced channel stresses both.
solutions.ur: Code 14 de raha unit par lamba parallel bank na chalayein; unbalanced channel dono ko stress deta hai.

source.title: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-S010002-05A)

meaning.en: Buck-boost current sensor No.1 has failed.
meaning.ur: Buck-boost current sensor No.1 kharab ho gaya hai.

causes.en: No.1 current sensing element failed
causes.ur: No.1 current sensing element kharab ho gaya

causes.en: Sensor wiring harness chafed or unplugged
causes.ur: Sensor wiring harness ragad ya nikal gaya

causes.en: Sense amplifier on the board failed
causes.ur: Board par sense amplifier kharab ho gaya

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then reseat the Buck-boost current sensor connector.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke Buck-boost current sensor ka connector dobara lagayein.

solutions.en: Compare each channel's reported current with a clamp meter to confirm which sensor is dead.
solutions.ur: Har channel ki reported current ko clamp meter se compare karke confirm karein ke kaunsa sensor kharab hai.

solutions.en: Replace the sensor with the exact Felicity part number and recalibrate both channels.
solutions.ur: Sensor ko exact Felicity part number se replace karke dono channels recalibrate karein.

source.title: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-S010002-05A)

meaning.en: Buck-boost current sensor No.2 has failed.
meaning.ur: Buck-boost current sensor No.2 kharab ho gaya hai.

causes.en: No.2 current sensing element failed
causes.ur: No.2 current sensing element kharab ho gaya

causes.en: Sensor harness routing pinched during fan replacement
causes.ur: Fan badalne ke dauran sensor harness ka routing nichal gaya

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery before opening the unit.
solutions.ur: Unit kholne se pehle AC, PV aur battery isolate karein.

solutions.en: Check the No.2 sensor harness for pinching and reseat its connector.
solutions.ur: No.2 sensor harness mein pinching dekhein aur uska connector dobara lagayein.

solutions.en: Replace the No.2 sensor with the exact part number and recalibrate.
solutions.ur: No.2 sensor ko exact part number se replace karke recalibrate karein.

source.title: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-S010002-05A)

meaning.en: The load stayed overloaded too long; reduce the connected load by switching off equipment.
meaning.ur: Load bohat der se overloaded raha; kuch equipment band karke connected load kam karein.

causes.en: Air conditioner compressor plus pump running together
causes.ur: Air conditioner ka compressor aur pump aik saath chal rahe hain

causes.en: Load shed set too slow for the actual demand
causes.ur: Load shed actual demand ke liye bohat dheere set hai

solutions.en: Switch off equipment one by one until the overload clears, then note the total running load.
solutions.ur: Equipment ko aik aik karke band karein jab tak overload na hat jaye, phir kul chal raha load note karein.

solutions.en: Set faster load-shed steps in the app so peaks are cut before the timeout trips.
solutions.ur: App mein tez load-shed steps set karein taake timeout se pehle peak kat jaye.

solutions.en: Upgrade the inverter if the measured demand is genuinely above this model's rating.
solutions.ur: Agar measured demand waqai is model ki rating se upar hai to bara inverter lagayein.

source.title: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-S010002-05A)

meaning.en: Output is short circuited; check the wiring and remove the faulty load.
meaning.ur: Output short circuited hai; wiring check karke kharab load nikaal dein.

causes.en: Damaged appliance on the backup circuit
causes.ur: Backup circuit par koi kharab appliance

causes.en: Cable pinched or crushed during installation
causes.ur: Installation ke dauran cable nichal ya crush hua

causes.en: Water in an outdoor socket on the backup board
causes.ur: Backup board ke outdoor socket mein paani

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then unplug loads one by one to find the shorted circuit.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke loads aik aik nikaalte jayein taake short wala circuit mil jaye.

solutions.en: With the inverter isolated, test each circuit to earth to locate the shorted cable.
solutions.ur: Inverter isolate karke har circuit ki earth ke saath continuity test karke short wala cable dhoondein.

solutions.en: Inspect the backup distribution board for water, burnt contacts or loose terminals.
solutions.ur: Backup distribution board mein paani, jale contacts ya dhile terminals dekhein.

source.title: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-S010002-05A)

meaning.en: Input and output wiring are not correct; confirm they correspond.
meaning.ur: Input aur output wiring theek nahi; confirm karein ke aik doosre se match karte hain.

causes.en: Grid and load cables swapped at the AC terminal block
causes.ur: AC terminal block par grid aur load ke cables aik doosre ki jagah lage hue hain

causes.en: Parallel installation not completed, so cables were landed by guesswork
causes.ur: Parallel installation mukammal nahi hua, is liye cables andaza se lagaye gaye

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery and confirm which AC terminals are grid and which are load.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke confirm karein ke kaun se AC terminals grid hain aur kaun se load.

solutions.en: Re-land the grid and load cables on the correct terminals and tighten to the specified torque.
solutions.ur: Grid aur load cables sahi terminals par dobara lagayein aur specified torque par tighten karein.

solutions.en: For a parallel bank, finish the parallel installation fully before restarting, as the manual instructs.
solutions.ur: Parallel bank mein, manual ke mutabiq parallel installation poora karke hi restart karein.

source.title: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-S010002-05A)

aliases: Output current sensor failed / OP current sensor failed

meaning.en: The output (OP) current sensor has failed; the unit has cut output.
meaning.ur: Output (OP) current sensor kharab ho gaya hai; unit ne output band kar diya hai.

causes.en: OP current sensing element failed
causes.ur: OP current sensing element kharab ho gaya

causes.en: Sensor connector loose on the board
causes.ur: Board par sensor connector dhila hai

causes.en: Sensor reading drift after a surge
causes.ur: Surge ke baad sensor ki reading drift ho gayi

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery and reseat the OP current sensor connector.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke OP current sensor ka connector dobara lagayein.

solutions.en: Compare the reported output current with a clamp meter on the output conductor.
solutions.ur: Output conductor par clamp meter se reported output current compare karein.

solutions.en: Have the sensor replaced and the output current channel calibrated at the service centre.
solutions.ur: Service centre par sensor replace aur output current channel calibrate karwayein.

source.title: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-S010002-05A)

meaning.en: The inverter output voltage is too low; reduce the connected load.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka output voltage bohat kam hai; connected load kam karein.

causes.en: Load too heavy for the inverter rating
causes.ur: Load inverter rating ke liye bohat bhaari hai

causes.en: Grid voltage sagging at the input
causes.ur: Input par grid voltage gir raha hai

causes.en: Inverter bridge or output filter capacitor degraded
causes.ur: Inverter bridge ya output filter capacitor degrade ho gaya

solutions.en: Reduce the connected load step by step until the output voltage recovers.
solutions.ur: Connected load qadam ba qadam kam karein jab tak output voltage recover na ho.

solutions.en: Measure the output voltage at the load board, not only at the inverter, to spot a long cable drop.
solutions.ur: Output voltage sirf inverter par nahi, load board par bhi measure karein taake lamba cable ka drop pata chale.

solutions.en: If voltage stays low with a light load, have the output stage and capacitors tested.
solutions.ur: Halki load par bhi voltage kam rahe to output stage aur capacitors test karwayein.

source.title: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-S010002-05A)

meaning.en: The inverter output voltage is above the permitted window; output has been cut.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka output voltage allowed range se upar hai; output band kar diya gaya hai.

causes.en: Backfeed from another inverter or a grid-tie unit on the same board
causes.ur: Aik hi board par doosre inverter ya grid-tie unit se backfeed

causes.en: Output voltage sensing circuit fault
causes.ur: Output voltage sensing circuit ki kharabi

causes.en: Load absorbing too little power for the generated voltage
causes.ur: Load itni kam power absorb kar raha hai ke generated voltage barh jata hai

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery and check for any other power source feeding the output board.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke dekhein ke output board ko koi aur power source to nahi feed kar raha.

solutions.en: Measure output voltage at the inverter and at the load board to see if the fault is real or a sensing error.
solutions.ur: Inverter aur load board dono par output voltage measure karke dekhein ke fault haqiqi hai ya sensing ka ghaltat hai.

solutions.en: Check the output voltage sensing divider and connector on the board.
solutions.ur: Board par output voltage sensing divider aur connector dekhein.

source.title: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-S010002-05A)

aliases: Over current or surge detected by Software

title.ur: Fault 24 Software ne over current/surge pakra

meaning.en: The inverter's software detected an overcurrent or surge; the unit has cut output.
meaning.ur: Inverter ke software ne over current ya surge detect kiya; unit ne output band kar diya hai.

causes.en: Large motor starting surge on the output
causes.ur: Output par bare motor ka starting surge

causes.en: Output transient from switching a large capacitor-input load
causes.ur: Bara capacitor-input load switch karne par output par transient

causes.en: Grid surge arriving through the AC input
causes.ur: AC input ke zariye grid surge andar aaya

solutions.en: Disconnect all loads and restart to confirm whether it is a load-side transient.
solutions.ur: Saare loads disconnect karke restart karein taake confirm ho ke load side ka transient hai.

solutions.en: Start large motors one at a time and note which one triggers the fault.
solutions.ur: Bare motors ko aik aik start karke note karein ke kaunsa fault trigger karta hai.

solutions.en: Add a surge protective device on the AC input and contactivity-bond the inverter earth.
solutions.ur: AC input par surge protective device lagayein aur inverter earth ko contactivity-bond karein.

source.title: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-S010002-05A)

aliases: Hardware detect over current at inverter port

title.en: Fault 25 Hardware overcurrent at inverter port
title.ur: Fault 25 Hardware ne inverter port par over current pakra

meaning.en: The hardware overcurrent comparator tripped at the inverter port; output cut.
meaning.ur: Hardware over current comparator ne inverter port par trip kiya; output band.

causes.en: Real hardware overcurrent from an overloaded or shorted output
causes.ur: Overloaded ya shorted output se haqiqi hardware over current

causes.en: Overcurrent comparator board fault giving a false trip
causes.ur: Over current comparator board ki kharabi se jhooti trip

causes.en: Inverter bridge device with increased leakage
causes.ur: Inverter bridge device ka leakage barh gaya

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then disconnect all output loads and re-test.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke saare output loads disconnect karke dobara test karein.

solutions.en: With loads off, measure the output for continuity to earth to rule out a shorted board.
solutions.ur: Load hatane ke baad output ki earth ke saath continuity measure karke shorted board rule out karein.

solutions.en: If it trips with no load, the comparator or bridge must be tested and replaced at the service centre.
solutions.ur: Bina load ke trip ho to comparator ya bridge service centre par test aur replace karna hoga.

codes.blinkPattern: Red fault LED on (fault, not warning)

notes.en: On this product, code 25 in the WARNING table is a completely different fault (phase sequence error). Always confirm which table the on-screen code came from.
notes.ur: Is product par WARNING table ka code 25 bilkul alag masla hai (phase sequence error). Hamesha confirm karein ke on-screen code kis table se aaya.

source.title: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-S010002-05A)

meaning.en: The inverter soft start did not complete normally; the unit has cut output.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka soft start theek se mukammal nahi hua; unit ne output band kar diya hai.

causes.en: Output heavily loaded or shorted at switch-on
causes.ur: Switch on par output bhaari load ya short

causes.en: Grid relay not switching cleanly
causes.ur: Grid relay saaf switch nahi ho raha

causes.en: Bus voltage not at the expected level before soft start
causes.ur: Soft start se pehle bus voltage expected level par nahi hai

solutions.en: Disconnect all output loads, then restart the unit empty.
solutions.ur: Saare output loads disconnect karke unit khaali restart karein.

solutions.en: Measure AC output voltage with a meter; an unstable reading points to the inverter stage.
solutions.ur: Meter se AC output voltage measure karein; unstable reading inverter stage ki kharabi batata hai.

solutions.en: Have the inverter stage and grid relay checked at the service centre if it fails empty.
solutions.ur: Khaali hokar bhi fail ho to inverter stage aur grid relay service centre par check karwayein.

source.title: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-S010002-05A)

meaning.en: The inverter current sensor has failed; the unit has cut output.
meaning.ur: Inverter current sensor kharab ho gaya; unit ne output band kar diya hai.

causes.en: Inverter current sensing element failed
causes.ur: Inverter current sensing element kharab ho gaya

causes.en: Sense wiring disconnected or chafed
causes.ur: Sense wiring nikal gayi ya ragad gayi

causes.en: Current sensor reading drifted after a surge
causes.ur: Surge ke baad current sensor ki reading drift ho gayi

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery and reseat the inverter current sensor connector.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke inverter current sensor ka connector dobara lagayein.

solutions.en: Compare the reported inverter current with a clamp meter on the output conductor.
solutions.ur: Output conductor par clamp meter se reported inverter current compare karein.

solutions.en: Have the sensor replaced and the measurement chain calibrated at the service centre.
solutions.ur: Service centre par sensor replace aur measurement chain calibrate karwayein.

source.title: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-S010002-05A)

meaning.en: The DC bus voltage is too low; the unit has cut output.
meaning.ur: DC bus ka voltage bohat kam hai; unit ne output band kar diya hai.

causes.en: Battery disconnected or its voltage too low to support the bus
causes.ur: Battery nahi hai ya uska voltage bus ko support karne ke liye bohat kam hai

causes.en: PV input too weak to charge the bus
causes.ur: PV input bus ko charge karne ke liye bohat kamzor hai

causes.en: Bus voltage sensing circuit fault
causes.ur: Bus voltage sensing circuit ki kharabi

solutions.en: Check the battery is connected, charged and within its voltage window on the LCD.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke battery lagi hai, charged hai aur uska voltage LCD par window ke andar hai.

solutions.en: Measure PV open-circuit voltage; a weak or wrongly configured string cannot raise the bus.
solutions.ur: PV ka open-circuit voltage measure karein; kamzor ya ghalat configured string bus nahi barha sakta.

solutions.en: Verify battery type is set correctly (lithium vs lead-acid) in the setup; a wrong setting misreads voltage.
solutions.ur: Setup mein battery type (lithium ya lead-acid) theek set hai ya nahi check karein; ghalat setting voltage ghalat parhti hai.

source.title: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-S010002-05A)

meaning.en: The DC bus voltage is too high, or an AC surge/internal component failed.
meaning.ur: DC bus ka voltage bohat zyada hai, ya AC surge/internal component fail hua hai.

causes.en: AC surge coming in from the grid
causes.ur: Grid se AC surge andar aaya

causes.en: PV string overvoltage driving the bus high
causes.ur: PV string ki over voltage bus ko high le gayi

causes.en: Internal component failure in the bus charge path
causes.ur: Bus charge path mein internal component ki failure

solutions.en: Measure PV open-circuit voltage at the DC isolator and reduce the string if it exceeds the limit.
solutions.ur: DC isolator par PV ka open-circuit voltage measure karke string chhota karein agar woh limit se zyada ho.

solutions.en: Check the AC SPD status; a spent AC SPD lets grid surges hit the bus directly.
solutions.ur: AC SPD status dekhein; kharab AC SPD grid surges ko seedha bus par maar deta hai.

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery before opening the unit, and have the bus circuit inspected.
solutions.ur: Unit kholne se pehle AC, PV aur battery isolate karein aur bus circuit ka muaina karwayein.

source.title: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-S010002-05A)

meaning.en: Bus soft start did not complete; the unit has cut output.
meaning.ur: Bus ka soft start mukammal nahi hua; unit ne output band kar diya hai.

causes.en: Bus pre-charge circuit not charging the capacitors
causes.ur: Bus ka pre-charge circuit capacitors charge nahi kar raha

causes.en: Input voltage below the minimum to start the boost stage
causes.ur: Input voltage boost stage shuru karne ke liye minimum se neeche hai

causes.en: Load connected at switch-on prevented the ramp
causes.ur: Switch on par load lagi hui thi jis se ramp nahi hua

solutions.en: Disconnect all output loads and restart once, as the manual instructs.
solutions.ur: Saare output loads disconnect karke manual ke mutabiq aik baar restart karein.

solutions.en: Measure PV and battery voltage and confirm both are above the inverter's start thresholds.
solutions.ur: PV aur battery voltage measure karke confirm karein ke dono inverter ke start thresholds se upar hain.

solutions.en: If it persists with no load, have the pre-charge resistor and boost stage tested.
solutions.ur: Bina load ke bhi jaari rahe to pre-charge resistor aur boost stage test karwayein.

source.title: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-S010002-05A)

aliases: Over temperature happen at heat sink

meaning.en: Over-temperature at the heat sink; check whether ambient temperature is too high.
meaning.ur: Heat sink par temperature zyada hai; check karein ke ambient temperature bohat zyada to nahi hai.

causes.en: Heat sink fins blocked with dust
causes.ur: Heat sink ki fins dhool se block hui hain

causes.en: Ambient temperature above the unit's rating
causes.ur: Ambient temperature unit ki rating se zyada hai

causes.en: Fan or internal fan not running
causes.ur: Fan ya internal fan nahi chal raha

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then clean the heat sink with a soft dry brush.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke heat sink ko soft dry brush se saaf karein.

solutions.en: Measure ambient temperature at the vents; improve ventilation or add shade if it is high.
solutions.ur: Vents par ambient temperature measure karein; zyada ho to ventilation behtar karein ya chhaan lagayein.

solutions.en: Check that both fans spin freely and their connectors are seated.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke dono fans azaad ghoomte hain aur unke connectors baithay hue hain.

source.title: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-S010002-05A)

title.ur: Fault 35 Internal temperature limit se upar

meaning.en: The internal temperature is over the limit; check whether ambient temperature is too high.
meaning.ur: Internal temperature limit se upar hai; check karein ke ambient temperature zyada to nahi hai.

causes.en: Unit installed in a closed, unventilated room
causes.ur: Unit band aur bina ventilation wale kamre mein lagi hai

causes.en: Direct sun on the cabinet
causes.ur: Cabinet par seedhi dhoop lag rahi hai

causes.en: Internal temperature sensor drifted
causes.ur: Internal temperature sensor drift ho gaya

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then clean the internal air path and heat sink.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke internal air path aur heat sink saaf karein.

solutions.en: Add cross ventilation or relocate the unit out of the closed space.
solutions.ur: Cross ventilation lagayein ya unit ko band jagah se bahar shift karein.

solutions.en: Check the internal NTC sensor resistance against a meter; a drifted sensor needs replacing.
solutions.ur: Meter se internal NTC sensor ki resistance check karein; drift ho gayi sensor ko replace karna hoga.

source.title: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-S010002-05A)

title.ur: Fault 36 Internal fan lock ho gaya

meaning.en: The internal fan is locked and not turning.
meaning.ur: Internal fan lock ho gaya hai aur nahi ghoom raha.

causes.en: Foreign object or packing material jammed in the fan
causes.ur: Fan mein koi cheez ya packing material phans gaya

causes.en: Fan bearing seized with age and dust
causes.ur: Umra aur dhool se fan ka bearing jam ho gaya

causes.en: Fan motor open circuit
causes.ur: Fan ka motor open circuit ho gaya

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery before opening the unit.
solutions.ur: Unit kholne se pehle AC, PV aur battery isolate karein.

solutions.en: Free the fan impeller by hand and remove any packing material or cable tie touching the blade.
solutions.ur: Fan ki impeller haath se azaad karein aur blade ko chhu raha koi packing material ya cable tie nikaalein.

solutions.en: Replace the internal fan with the same part number if it is seized or open circuit.
solutions.ur: Internal fan jam ho ya open circuit ho to wahi part number ka fan lagayein.

source.title: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-S010002-05A)

aliases: Isolation resistance to ground of the PV string is too low

title.en: Fault 40 PV string insulation to earth too low
title.ur: Fault 40 PV string ki earth insulation bohat kam

meaning.en: Isolation resistance of the PV string to ground is too low; there is a leakage path.
meaning.ur: PV string ki earth se isolation resistance bohat kam hai; leakage path hai.

causes.en: PV string shorted to the array frame
causes.ur: PV string array frame se short ho gaya

causes.en: Water inside a PV junction box
causes.ur: PV junction box ke andar paani

causes.en: Cable insulation damaged by UV or rodents
causes.ur: UV ya chuho se cable ki insulation kharab

solutions.en: Isolate PV at the DC isolator; never megger a live array.
solutions.ur: DC isolator se PV isolate karein; live array par megger na lagayein.

solutions.en: Megohmmeter-test each string to earth separately to find the leaking string.
solutions.ur: Har string ko alag alag earth ke khilaf megohmmeter se test karke leak wala dhoondein.

solutions.en: Open, dry and re-seal junction boxes, then replace any panel or cable that still fails the test.
solutions.ur: Junction boxes khol ke sukha dein aur dobara seal karein, phir fail hone wala panel ya cable replace karein.

source.title: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-S010002-05A)

meaning.en: The unit's self-test of the relay found a problem; output has been cut.
meaning.ur: Unit ne relay ka self test kiya aur masla mila; output band kar diya gaya hai.

causes.en: Grid relay contacts welded or not closing within the test window
causes.ur: Grid relay ke contacts weld ho gaye ya test time mein band nahi hue

causes.en: Relay coil open circuit
causes.ur: Relay coil open circuit ho gayi

causes.en: Relay wiring or connector loose
causes.ur: Relay wiring ya connector dhila hai

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then test the relay coil for continuity.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke relay coil ki continuity test karein.

solutions.en: Test the relay contacts for continuity when energised; an open reading means replace the relay.
solutions.ur: Relay energise kar ke contacts ki continuity test karein; open reading aaye to relay replace karein.

solutions.en: Reseat the relay connector and re-tighten the relay wiring before replacing parts.
solutions.ur: Relay connector dobara lagayein aur relay wiring dobara tighten karein, phir parts replace karein.

source.title: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-S010002-05A)

title.ur: Fault 43 Parallel CAN communication abnormal hai

meaning.en: Parallel CAN communication between units is abnormal.
meaning.ur: Units ke darmiyan parallel CAN communication abnormal hai.

causes.en: Parallel CAN cable loose or missing termination resistors
causes.ur: Parallel CAN cable dhili hai ya termination resistors mojood nahi

causes.en: CAN cable run alongside AC power cables
causes.ur: CAN cable AC power cables ke saath chal raha hai

causes.en: Different firmware versions across the parallel bank
causes.ur: Parallel bank mein firmware versions alag hain

solutions.en: Power off, test the parallel CAN cable end to end with a meter and reseat every connector.
solutions.ur: Power off karke parallel CAN cable ki end-to-end continuity meter se test karein aur har connector dobara lagayein.

solutions.en: Fit the termination resistors as the manual specifies, at both ends of the CAN run.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq CAN run ke dono sifar par termination resistors lagayein.

solutions.en: Update all units to the same firmware version, then restart the bank.
solutions.ur: Saare units ko aik hi firmware version par update karke bank restart karein.

source.title: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-S010002-05A)

meaning.en: The parallel system has lost the host unit; contact after-sales if it persists.
meaning.ur: Parallel system ne host unit kho diya hai; agar jaari rahe to after-sales se rabta karein.

causes.en: Host unit switched off or lost AC supply
causes.ur: Host unit band ho gaya ya uski AC supply chala gaya

causes.en: Host unit reporting its own fault so it drops out of the bank
causes.ur: Host unit apna koi fault de raha hai jis se woh bank se nikal jata hai

causes.en: CAN link intermittent between host and this unit
causes.ur: Host aur is unit ke darmiyan CAN link intermittent hai

solutions.en: Walk the bank and read every unit's own fault code; fix the host's error first.
solutions.ur: Bank mein jaan kar har unit ka apna fault code padhein; pehle host ka error theek karein.

solutions.en: Test the parallel communication line with a meter, then restart; if it persists contact after-sales.
solutions.ur: Parallel communication line ko meter se test karke restart karein; phir bhi rahe to after-sales se rabta karein.

solutions.en: Confirm the host unit's AC supply and its ON/OFF switch are healthy.
solutions.ur: Host unit ki AC supply aur uska ON/OFF switch theek hai ya nahi confirm karein.

source.title: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-S010002-05A)

title.ur: Fault 46 Parallel units ka firmware version mismatch

meaning.en: The units in the parallel bank do not run the same firmware version.
meaning.ur: Parallel bank ke units aik hi firmware version par nahi chal rahe.

causes.en: One unit was updated and the others were not
causes.ur: Aik unit update hua lekin baqi nahi

causes.en: CPU versions differ between the main and auxiliary processor firmware
causes.ur: Main aur auxiliary processor ke firmware ke CPU versions alag hain

solutions.en: Update all inverter firmware in the bank to the same version, as the manual instructs.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq bank ke sabhi inverter ka firmware aik hi version par update karein.

solutions.en: Check each unit's version through the LCD settings and confirm the CPU versions match.
solutions.ur: LCD settings se har unit ka version dekhein aur confirm karein ke CPU versions aik jaise hain.

solutions.en: If the fault remains after updating, contact after-sales for the correct firmware file.
solutions.ur: Update ke baad bhi fault bache to sahi firmware file ke liye after-sales se rabta karein.

source.title: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-S010002-05A)

title.ur: Fault 47 Parallel settings consistent nahi hain

meaning.en: Parallel system setup error: single-phase and grouped three-phase modes are mixed, or the group is incomplete.
meaning.ur: Parallel system setup error: single-phase aur group three-phase modes mila diye gaye hain ya group adhoora hai.

causes.en: Some units set to single-phase parallel and others to three-phase group
causes.ur: Kuch units single-phase parallel par aur baqi three-phase group par set hain

causes.en: Parallel mode not completed before the units were switched on
causes.ur: Parallel mode mukammal kiye bina hi units on kar diye gaye

solutions.en: Check LCD program 28 on every unit; all units in one bank must have the same setting.
solutions.ur: Har unit ka LCD program 28 dekhein; aik bank ke sabhi units ka setting aik jaisa hona chahiye.

solutions.en: For a three-phase group, assign 3P1/3P2/3P3 to match the actual phase of each unit.
solutions.ur: Three-phase group ke liye 3P1/3P2/3P3 har unit ke asal phase ke mutabiq set karein.

solutions.en: Finish the parallel setup completely, then power-cycle the whole bank once.
solutions.ur: Parallel setup poora karke poore bank ko aik baar power-cycle karein.

source.title: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-S010002-05A)

meaning.en: EEPROM has failed; stored settings may be lost.
meaning.ur: EEPROM kharab ho gaya hai; stored settings kho sakti hain.

causes.en: Power cut while settings were being written
causes.ur: Settings likhte waqt power cut ho gaya

causes.en: EEPROM chip damaged by surge or heat
causes.ur: Surge ya garmi se EEPROM chip kharab ho gaya

solutions.en: Back up the current settings from the app before touching the unit.
solutions.ur: Unit chhoone se pehle app se current settings ka backup bana lein.

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then power-cycle once and check whether code 50 clears.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke aik baar power-cycle karein aur dekhein ke code 50 hatta ya nahi.

solutions.en: If code 50 stays, the EEPROM or control board must be replaced at the service centre.
solutions.ur: Code 50 bache to EEPROM ya control board service centre par replace karna hoga.

source.title: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-S010002-05A)

meaning.en: The second DSP is not communicating normally.
meaning.ur: Doosra DSP normally communicate nahi kar raha.

causes.en: DSP2 ribbon cable or connector loose
causes.ur: DSP2 ribbon cable ya connector dhila hai

causes.en: Firmware versions mismatched between the two processors
causes.ur: Dono processors ke firmware versions mismatch hain

causes.en: DSP2 processor failed
causes.ur: DSP2 processor kharab ho gaya

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then reseat the DSP2 ribbon cable on the control board.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke control board par DSP2 ribbon cable dobara lagayein.

solutions.en: Update the inverter firmware so both processor versions match.
solutions.ur: Inverter firmware update karein taake dono processor versions match ho jayein.

solutions.en: If the fault remains, have the DSP2 processor and its solder joints inspected at the service centre.
solutions.ur: Fault bache to service centre par DSP2 processor aur uske solder joints ka muaina karwayein.

source.title: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-S010002-05A)

meaning.en: A temperature sensor is disconnected, so the unit cannot protect itself thermally.
meaning.ur: Aik temperature sensor nikal gaya hai, is liye unit khud ko thermal protection nahi kar sakta.

causes.en: NTC sensor connector unplugged during a service visit
causes.ur: Service ke dauran NTC sensor ka connector nikal gaya

causes.en: Sensor cable chafed against a heatsink or bracket
causes.ur: Sensor cable heatsink ya bracket se ragad gaya

causes.en: NTC sensor open circuit
causes.ur: NTC sensor open circuit ho gaya

solutions.en: Isolate AC, PV and battery, then reseat every NTC sensor connector on the board.
solutions.ur: AC, PV aur battery isolate karke board par har NTC sensor connector dobara lagayein.

solutions.en: Measure each NTC resistance at room temperature and compare with the sensor's specification.
solutions.ur: Har NTC ki room temperature par resistance measure karke sensor ki specification se compare karein.

solutions.en: Replace an open or drifted NTC with the same part number; do not bypass thermal protection.
solutions.ur: Open ya drift ho chuki NTC ko wahi part number se replace karein; thermal protection bypass na karein.

source.title: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-S010002-05A)

meaning.en: Arcing has been detected in the photovoltaic system; check the wiring.
meaning.ur: Photovoltaic system mein arc detect hua hai; wiring check karein.

causes.en: MC4 connector not fully mated, so contacts arc under load
causes.ur: MC4 connector poori tarah fit nahi, load ke sath contacts arc karte hain

causes.en: Cable insulation chafed against metal
causes.ur: Cable ki insulation metal se ragad gayi

causes.en: Connector terminals burnt or loose
causes.ur: Connector terminals jale ya dhile hue hain

solutions.en: Isolate PV at the DC isolator and the AC side before inspecting any DC connector.
solutions.ur: Koi bhi DC connector dekhoon se pehle DC isolator se PV aur AC side band karein.

solutions.en: De-mate and re-mate every MC4 pair until each clicks firmly; discard any connector that is scorched.
solutions.ur: Har MC4 pair ko nikal kar dobara laga dein jab tak mazbooti se click na ho; jale hue connector phenk dein.

solutions.en: Replace scorched connectors and cables with new certified parts; never tape an arc-damaged connector.
solutions.ur: Jale hue connectors aur cables naye certified parts se replace karein; arc se kharab connector par tape na lagayein.

source.title: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-S010002-05A)

title.ur: Fault 87 Parallel CAN communication mein masla

meaning.en: The inverter reports abnormal parallel CAN communication inside the system.
meaning.ur: Inverter system ke andar parallel CAN communication abnormal report karta hai.

causes.en: CAN cable loose or a connector not seated
causes.ur: CAN cable dhili hai ya connector baitha nahi hua

causes.en: Different firmware versions in the bank
causes.ur: Bank mein firmware versions alag hain

causes.en: Phase assignment (3P1/3P2/3P3) not matching the actual wiring
causes.ur: Phase assignment (3P1/3P2/3P3) asal wiring se match nahi karti

solutions.en: With power off, test the CAN wiring continuity and reseat all CAN connectors.
solutions.ur: Power off karke CAN wiring ki continuity test karein aur sab CAN connectors dobara lagayein.

solutions.en: Confirm each unit's phase assignment in LCD program 28 matches the phase it is actually wired to.
solutions.ur: LCD program 28 mein har unit ka phase assignment us ki asal wiring se match karwata hai ya nahi confirm karein.

solutions.en: Update every unit to the same firmware and restart the bank once.
solutions.ur: Har unit ko aik hi firmware par update karke bank ko aik baar restart karein.

source.title: IVGM4K6/5K/6K LP1G1 Hybrid Inverter User Guide (358-S010002-05A)
